summary: Eolian, L.P. supports the June 18 orders and asks FERC to clarify or rehear one limit: permanent load-limited generator interconnection service for electrically proximate front-of-the-meter generation, and the flexibility RTOs have to adopt minimal generator study reforms.
ask: Clarify that electrically proximate generation may access permanent load-limited interconnection service, that RTOs are encouraged to offer it, and that minimal generator study reforms do not suffice; otherwise grant rehearing.

points.point: Eolian says the orders allow permanent load-limited generator service only for co-located generation and make it temporary for electrically proximate generation.
points.quote: the Commission appears to categorically limit the availability of permanent generator interconnection services to co-located generation

points.point: It says limited generator service will limit uptake of the new permanent contract demand and Interim NITS services.
points.quote: large loads’ ability to make use of the new transmission services will be severely limited if new front-of-the-meter generation projects

points.point: Eolian asks FERC to confirm RTOs may offer permanent load-limited generator interconnection service and to encourage broad availability.
points.quote: the Commission strongly encourage RTO/ISOs to make such service broadly available.

points.point: Eolian asks FERC to close language that could let RTOs adopt minimal generator interconnection reforms.
points.quote: The Commission must clarify this discussion, so that it does not inadvertently create a loophole that would undermine the critical benefits of its Orders

points.point: Eolian says large loads cannot use the new services widely unless new generation can interconnect without queue cost and timing uncertainty.
points.quote: Large loads will not be able to transact with new front-of-the-meter resources if resource developers face significant commercial barriers to interconnection

throughLine.text: Rehearing and clarification request across the PJM, NYISO, MISO, CAISO and ISO-NE show cause orders on generator interconnection service for generation serving electrically proximate large loads.
